text:
alex (VP Eng): Quick heads-up — internal pilot for Private Identity Sync (SAML + SCIM) is opening next week for a small set of on-prem/VPC customers. This is an opt-in preview, not GA. 

elena (PM, Private): TL;DR: pilot goals = validate SAML handshake across customer IdPs, SCIM push for groups/users, offline provisioning for air-gapped installs, and audit log fidelity. Target pilot cohort = 6 customers. Rollout plan in thread below. 

samira (Infra): Packaging: private-identity-sync v0.9.0 will be included in the onprem bundle. Image tags: redwood/private-identity-sync:0.9.0-rc1. Deployment is a sidecar in the control-plane pod by default; can be disabled. Quick config sample: 
```yaml
# enable identity sync (onprem)
identitySync:
  enabled: true
  mode: saml_scim
  saml:
    allow_insecure_metadata: false
  scim:
    base_url: https://scim.local
```
kubectl apply -f onprem-config.yaml
```

ryan (Security): Important security notes:
- SCIM pushes are encrypted end-to-end; ensure KMS/HSM integration is configured for customer key wrap.
- SAML metadata must be locally validated — do NOT accept automatic metadata fetch unless customer explicitly permits.
- Audit logs for identity events are now routed to the audit log sink (customer-managed) and to the platform’s readonly retention for 30 days by default. We need legal/controls sign-off for longer retention.

maria (Solutions): Customer readiness checklist (short):
- IdP contact and metadata (entityID + cert) collected
- SCIM endpoint reachable from customer control plane
- KMS key available and rotated at least once during pilot
- Support contact assigned for first 2 weeks after enablement
I’ll send the form to the pilot cohort list.

elena (PM, Private): Pilot timeline:
- Wed: internal enable for Redwood demo cluster (QA)
- Mon: begin 6-customer onboarding (staggered)
- 2 weeks: collect logs, compatibility issues, latency/scale metrics
- 4 weeks: decide GA readiness or iterate on breaking issues
We will use canary policy: enable on 1 customer, monitor 48h, then continue if no criticals.

alex (VP Eng): Ops/Rollback guidance: if we see failed SCIM pushes >5% or repeated SAML assertion errors, flip `identitySync.enabled=false` and rollback control-plane to previous image (0.8.x). Samira, add rollback playbook to Runbook.

samira (Infra): Added. Runbook link: https://internal.redwood/runbooks/onprem-identity-sync (internal only). Deploy-bot will track canary progress.

deploy-bot: Deployment scheduled: 1960054600 — image redwood/private-identity-sync:0.9.0-rc1 applied to redwood-demo cluster. Canary window = 48h. 

maria (Solutions): Heads-up to Customer Success: please prioritize customers that already use our private control plane and have a designated IdP admin. We will require consent to share anonymized telemetry for the pilot.

ryan (Security): One more: telemetry scope limited to operational metrics (latency, error rates) + schema-level counts. No user PII will be collected. Logging for audit events is customer-managed by default; confirm with each customer during onboarding.

elena (PM, Private): Action items:
- @samira add rollback steps to runbook (due EOD today)
- @maria share pilot onboarding form (due EOD tomorrow)
- @ryan confirm legal note for telemetry opt-in (due +2 days)
- eng-oncall: monitor canary; escalate to alex if SLO breach > 5m sustained

alex (VP Eng): Thanks team — this is a big enabler for regulated customers. Will update execs after week 1 of pilot. If anyone needs access to the QA demo cluster to validate IdP integrations, DM me or elena. :rocket:

samira (Infra): FYI — for air-gapped installs we provide a tarball and offline metadata instructions. Private support will coordinate registry sync windows with customers.

maria (Solutions): I’ll post the customer signup form in #customer-success after I get the final list. 

alex (VP Eng): Ok closing the loop here. I’ll post an internal summary after the first canary finishes. :thumbsup:
